desc: 在拉普拉斯度过的第一个生日，小春雀儿意外收到了来自各个部门的特制生日徽章。她敏锐地发现：它们好像都是由导师玛格丽特女士的神秘学打印机制作出来的。|拆生日礼物时，小春雀儿发现了一本未署名的《间谍工作指南》。这天接下来的时间，她都花在了认真研读这本指南上。|在这个时代的阿灵顿公墓寻找三小时无果后，小春雀儿回到了旅店，对着褪色的绶带汇报起了自己过去一年中的成长。

character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于20世纪10年代，参展时长16年，诞生自7月21日夏。展出地点为美利坚合众国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区，现活跃于拉普拉斯科算中心，偶见于洛伦兹研究所。

尺寸：61 1/32×21 21/32×7 7/8in.
介质：徽章
香调：甘苔调 薄荷 小豆蔻 三叶草 橡木苔
灵感：光合的新枝[木] 环境感知

character_data.title: 一体式粒子探测成像仪
character_data.text:
“在启动前需要按照长达五十四页的检查手册执行，以防止误操作引发爆炸。”
导师曾如此叮嘱受访者。但在上手使用过后，受访者发现唯一的操作指南是：不要把枪口对准自己。

character_data.title: “新的绿地”
character_data.text: 她亲手将布料裁成了绶带的形状。仔细对比后，她才发现新绶带比父亲过去的那条要明亮些许，但她还是郑重地为自己佩戴上了它。至于那条已经褪色的旧绶带，则沉甸甸地挂在受访者于科算中心总部的宿舍里。

character_data.title: “于科学中振翅”
character_data.titleEn: Wings of a Newly Fledged Scientist
character_data.text: 一只最简单的领结，一道最微不足道的暗示。谁能凭借它指认受访者为“洛伦兹研究所成员”呢？这只是一只再普通不过的蝴蝶结。

character_data.title: 变化的，不变的
character_data.titleEn: What Remains Unchanged in Ever-Changing Times
character_data.text:
两个背道而驰的选择摆在她眼前：一个是某个科研机构的实习聘用书，而另一个是她曾无比向往的柠檬水和饼干。
在那之后，“暴雨”一次又一次地来，带来新的潮流、新的规章、新的机会。但它又一次次地走，带走时代，带走回忆，带走可能性。有些时代走得格外快，快到让忙碌的人无暇将目光落在眼前以外的地方。
在这样的世界里，童子军的时代也来了又去。灰绿军服的孩子们风头无两，转眼间又被时代的海浪冲散。
但赤诚是无法被浇灭的火。
男孩、女孩，稚童、少年。不分性别与年龄，这些灰绿色的身影用诚实、勇敢与奉献点燃着周围的空气。
而这一次，她会在银色的王国里燃烧，比任何人都烧得热烈。

character_data.title: 科算中心总部入职安全检查
character_data.text:
【毛呢外套】提花毛呢格纹大衣一件，无品牌。根据员工提交的资料，此为员工母亲亲手缝制。准入意见：同意。
【童子军外套】豆绿童子军制服一套，无品牌。员工背景资料中并未有童子军注册记录，根据员工的辅助说明，此为“个人爱好”。准入意见：同意。
【徽章绶带】军用绶带一条及徽章若干，陈旧，未见神秘术能量反应。准入意见：同意。
【学力认证报告】由总部研究员X签字证明，该员工已具备科算中心实习人员标准的学力，符合入职标准。准入意见：同意，请在入职后尽快将证明交至人事委员会存档。
【苹果挞】弗吉尼亚州特产苹果挞一盘，桦树蜜调馅，肉桂撒粉。准入意见：同意，但请勿放置于员工休息室，除非你原本就打算与同事分享。

character_data.title: 饼干与柠檬水
character_data.text:
白雪松：你长高了。
银装小春雀儿：是的，女士。我没想到还会再次见到您……至少见到了您的嘴巴。
白雪松：至于其他，倒是看起来和以前一样。
银装小春雀儿：我对于神秘术的掌控已经不同往日了，而且您刚刚才提到过我长高了……
白雪松：我的意思是，你看起来依然敏锐、冷静。难道你没有青春期吗？
银装小春雀儿：当然是有的。如果不是科算中心总部医务室的特效药，我的青春痘不会好得这么快。
白雪松：瞧瞧这些科学怪人把一个神秘学家小孩儿变成了什么样吧。
白雪松：看来这次采访也得不到什么能登上《UTTU》封面的独家秘闻了。
银装小春雀儿：我很抱歉没能帮上您的忙，女士。
白雪松：不，不需道歉。你这样就很好，保持冷静，保持敏锐，像真正的童子军一样。

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 又见面了，维尔汀小姐，拉普拉斯科算中心实习生小春雀儿向您报到。#0|与上次见面相比，我长高了些许，希望您还能认出我。#5.5
character_voice.encontent: It's really great to see you again, Ms. Vertin—oh—LSCC Intern Researcher Eagle, reporting in! #0|I hope you still recognize me ... I've gotten a little taller.#8.4

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 探测器显示，今天有73.2%的可能会下雨。#0|即便是如此先进的技术，#4.2|也不能完美预言环境的变化。#6.2
character_voice.encontent: My detector shows a 73.2% chance of precipitation today. #0|But even using the latest technology with precision accuracy down to ten decimal places, #6.2|we still can't always predict what tomorrow will bring.#13

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 玛格丽特老师说，如果我能熟练地将神秘术结合进探测技术中，#0|之后说不定可以写出一篇很有价值的论文，我会向着这个方向继续努力的。#5.1
character_voice.encontent: Ms. Marguerite once said that if I could find a way to incorporate my arcane skill into these detection devices in a reproducible method, #0|then she would help me publish a paper on it. I always find working toward a clear goal helps me focus.#9.4

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 箱子中不同位置、不同房间的能量场几乎完全不同，#0|就像这里同时存在着许多个独立的世界一样，真是神奇……#3.9
character_voice.encontent: I never picked up on it before, but each room—no, almost every location here—has its own energy field. #0|It's as if there were many independent worlds coexisting within the same space. It's truly amazing ...#10.6

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 箱子中不同位置、不同房间的能量场几乎完全不同，#0|就像这里同时存在着许多个独立的世界一样，真是神奇……#3.9
character_voice.encontent: I never picked up on it before, but each room—no, almost every location here—has its own energy field. #0|It's as if there were many independent worlds coexisting within the same space. It's truly amazing ...#10.6

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 您好，有什么需要我帮忙处理的工作吗？#0|分析数据、总结报告、整理文件、代写书信、收发物品和泡咖啡都可以。#3.1
character_voice.encontent: Is there anything I can do around here? #0|Analyze data, file reports, organize documents, draft letters, handle parcels, make coffee—whatever's needed.#2.8

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 早上好，在工作之前您需要来点咖啡吗？#0|如果来不及午休，这能拯救您的整个下午，玛格丽特老师平常都是这样做的。#3.6
character_voice.encontent: Good morning! Before we get going today, would you like some coffee? #0|It's just the thing to help you get through a long day—at least that's what Ms. Marguerite says.#5.7

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 我并不讨厌现在的工作生活，但这样无所事事的早晨，总让我格外怀念小时候。#0|那时我常一个人起个大早，跑到郊外练习如何又快又稳地扎好帐篷。#6.4
character_voice.encontent: I really enjoy my current duties, but these quiet, monotonous mornings at my desk make me miss being a little kid. #0|I remember waking up before everyone else and hurrying outside to set up camp as quickly as I could ...#9.3

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 您还没有休息吗？#0|为事业献身固然很伟大，不过与身体健康相比，没有什么工作是必须熬夜完成的。#1.5
character_voice.encontent: You're still working?! #0|As much as I empathize with wanting to do your best, you should never neglect your health! Work can wait until morning.#2.7

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 能和您在这样静谧的夜晚谈话，就像小时候的梦想一样：#0|和朋友一起在野营帐篷里过夜，围着篝火分享心事……#4.6|这样一想，箱子怎么不算一个住满了朋友的、大大的帐篷呢？#9.4
character_voice.encontent: I enjoy our nighttime talks. It feels just like my childhood dreams—#0|spending the night camping, gathering by the bonfire, and chatting in our tent until we drift off to sleep. #5.9|Now that I think about it, the Suitcase is just like one big tent filled with all our friends, isn't it?#13.2

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 拉普拉斯的员工服采用了特殊的材料，#0|轻便、抗皱，最重要的是，它们全都有绝缘和阻燃效果。#3|据说这是为了那些总是进行危险实验的研究员们特地开发的，#8.3|幸好我在工作中，还没有真正遇见过需要它发挥作用的场面。#12.8
character_voice.encontent: Laplace's uniforms are made of a special material. #0|It's light, wrinkle-resistant, and most importantly, insulated and fireproof. #3.8|They say it's to protect researchers during dangerous experiments ... #11.1|Luckily, I haven't had to test that out for myself yet.#15.8

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 您好奇这台一体式粒子探测成像仪吗？#0|这是老师和X先生共同为我设计的，#3.3|除了最先进的环境扫描功能，还配备了中等强度的能量发射装置。#6.5|是的，我的老师很在意我在外出执行任务时的自保能力……#12
character_voice.encontent: You mean this All-in-One Particle Detector? #0|It's a joint design between Ms. Marguerite and Mr. X. #3.4|Not only does it have the most advanced detection hardware, but it also includes a medium-intensity energy beam emitter. #8|Yes ... I suppose Ms. Marguerite is quite serious, maybe even overenthusiastic, about my ability to protect myself in the field.#15.9

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 父亲的军徽……我始终带在身上，#0|每天睡前将它拿出来擦拭的时候，就能感到父亲的力量仍然支持着我，#3.4|让我从那些复杂课业中坚持下来。#8.9
character_voice.encontent: This was my father's insignia ... I like to keep it close. #0|Every night, when I polish it, it's almost like he's there with me. #5.5|I think that's what gives me the strength to get through all the challenges of my training.#11.6

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 入职科算中心后，收集徽章变得困难了很多，#0|这里的成绩奖励大多以特批假期和年终奖金的方式来结算，#4.1|老师告诉我，这才是大人最喜欢的“奖章”。#9.1
character_voice.encontent: Since I started working at Laplace, earning merit badges hasn't been quite so straightforward. #0|They're usually given out as holidays or year-end bonuses now, #6.8|or "grown-up badges," Ms. Marguerite calls them.#10.5

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 对，按下合并图像按钮，这样我们就可以对比多种图表的波形来分析环境情况了。#0|您的操作真是专业，看不出来是初学者，#6.5|我第一次接触这些复杂设备的时候，可是焦头烂额地学了好久呢。#9.8
character_voice.encontent: That's correct. By clicking the "merge" button there, we can compare multiple waveforms to analyze what's happening around us. #0|You don't seem like a novice at all—much better than I was when I started. #9.9|I still start to sweat a little just thinking about that day!#16.3

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 或许我离成为一名正式研究员还有很遥远的距离，#0|但……我现在一定比一名鹰级童子军要厉害得多，您说对吗？#4.3
character_voice.encontent: I know I still have a lot to learn before I can become an official researcher, #0|but ... I've made a lot of progress from my days as an Eagle Scout, haven't I?#5.2

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 成为实习生后，要学的东西总是很多，每当我觉得自己已经做得不错时，#0|就会有更多令我感到无知的事情出现，想要成为一个合格的大人，究竟要努力多久呢？#5.9
character_voice.encontent: Every day, I find new things to learn, and every time I think I've got the hang of something, #0|more challenges appear for me to rise up to meet. I wonder how much longer it will be before I can call myself a grown-up.#6.8

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 维尔汀小姐和玛格丽特老师一样，#0|无论何时何地都保持着从容冷静。我要怎样才能掌握这样的能力呢……#2.6|我会以您为榜样，多加观察学习的。#9.7
character_voice.encontent: You and Ms. Marguerite are very different people, #0|but at the same time I see something between you—a shared sense of composure. I hope I can share it too one day ... #3.3|But until then, I'll try to follow your example as best as I can.#14.6

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 我现在仍向往成为一名优秀的军人，就像父亲那样。#0|但我想，成为军人的意义大概就是帮助与保护更多的人，#4.6|那么，或许我现在所学的知识、所做的工作，已经算做到了这一点吧，#9.9|或者说……我正走在正确的路上。#16.8
character_voice.encontent: I still want to become a soldier one day—a good one, like my father, #0|who protected people in need. Although I'm not in the military right now, #5.3|my training will allow me to help people in a similar way. #11.1|So, I think I'm still on the right track.#15.1

character_voice.content: 为您效劳！#0
character_voice.encontent: Eagle, reporting in!#0

character_voice.encontent: Beginning data collection.#0

character_voice.encontent: Fire mode on.#0

character_voice.content: 已达到最大功率！#0
character_voice.encontent: We're at full power!#0

character_voice.encontent: Compressing energy.#0

character_voice.content: 深呼吸……#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 不能退缩……#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 需要我将本次战斗的能量波动情况总结成报告吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: What's next? Should I whip up a report on ambient energy fluctuations during the fight?#0

skin.name: 银装小春雀儿
skin.skinDescription: 一二三，列队，立正！采集数据！

1371041.content: 您好，维尔汀小姐！您不介意我在箱子里进行一些探测工作吧？
虽然玛格丽特老师没有给我布置相关的任务，但学习到各种新的知识与技术后，我总是忍不住想去实践。
我本来也以为自己在科算中心里无法跟上大家的脚步，但实际体验下来，发现并没有原来想的那样可怕。
就像想象在执行童子军的任务一样——专注、思考、行动。只要坚持下去，总会有攻克难关的时候。
或者说，兴趣就是最好的老师？
有很多！现在我的神秘术运用得更加熟练了，而且配合粒子探测成像仪，可以用上更多分析方法。
比如说，箱子里很多看似完全不同的景观与地貌，本质上都是由同一种能量粒子通过不同的排列方式组合形成的。
但对这些粒子进行具体分析，需要用到更复杂庞大的仪器，可惜我还没有学到那么深的领域。

1371042.content: 不好意思，我刚刚在发呆。记得以前我总是喜欢在箱子里的这片地方练习扎帐篷……
现在每天忙于学习和研究，我已经很久没有做过这些了，说不定手艺都荒废了。
哈哈，谢谢您的好意，不过我的野营工具都留在家里了，手边只有这台沉沉的探测仪。
但是和您一起坐在这里聊天的感觉，还是和过去一样。这就够了。
帐篷和篝火都是次要的，和朋友一起度过的时光才是野营最宝贵的回忆。
说实话，肯定是有些累的，但比起疲惫，我的感受更多是充实。
玛格丽特老师说，人不应浪费自己的天赋。就像您和我都找到了适合自己的位置。
虽然忙碌，但我们也做到了更多的事，帮助了更多的人。这就够了。

1371041.content: 看来你很适应在拉普拉斯的生活
和从前在箱子里时相比，有什么新发现吗？

1371042.content: 让我陪你再扎一次帐篷吧
